# Capture. Understand. Act.
Hardware and app facts published on shop.cnps.ai — nothing beyond those listings.


- 

## Capture
Record meetings, lectures, and calls on the card or earbuds.
- 

## Understand
Transcription in 120+ languages, summaries and mind maps in the app.
- 

## Act
Ask the recording questions and pull out action items.


## TicNote hardware

- Card: 64GB (about 434 hours). See TicNote.
- Pods: 32GB case and 256MB on the earbuds. See Pods WiFi and Pods 4G.
- Lite is listed as a lighter recorder for meetings and lectures.


## Wearable displays

- AR Smart Glasses: diffractive optical lens micro-display, anti-glare coating, quad-core ARM 1.5 GHz, dual directional stereo, capacitive temple touch. Vendor CNPS.AI, SKU CNPS-PVG1.
- INMO GO3: 53g, binocular green MicroLED + diffractive waveguide, 640×480, up to 1500 nits, FOV 30°, dual-core CPU, RTOS, 256MB + 64GB, 4 mic + 2 speaker, 270 mAh unit / 1300 mAh case, BT 5.4, Wi-Fi 2.4G. Vendor CNPS.AI, SKU IMG301.
